data.name: RubisCO2
data.description: RubisCO2 is an early-stage startup founded by Pablo Navarro Maldonado that transforms Sargassum algae blooms into biochar, aiming to decarbonize construction while tackling coastal seaweed pollution. The company has tested prototype pyrolysis reactors in Mexico and participated in the EIT Climate-KIC Carbon Removal ClimAccelerator. The founder is based in Munich while the technical team operates in Guadalajara, Mexico.
